description: This file contains server request handlers for static files, directories, scripts, JSON responses, authentication, and error handling within a web server framework.

classes.name: DirectoryHandler
classes.description: Handles directory listing responses, generating HTML with directory contents.

classes.name: FileHandler
classes.description: Serves static files, supports range requests, and can process file headers and pipelines.

classes.name: PythonScriptHandler
classes.description: Executes Python scripts as request handlers.

classes.name: FunctionHandler
classes.description: Wraps a function to handle requests, managing exceptions and response content.

classes.name: JsonHandler
classes.description: Wraps a function to produce JSON responses.

classes.name: AsIsHandler
classes.description: Serves files as-is from the filesystem.

classes.name: BasicAuthHandler
classes.description: Wraps a handler with Basic Authentication.

classes.name: ErrorHandler
classes.description: Generates error responses with specified status codes.

classes.name: StaticHandler
classes.description: Serves static content with template substitution.

methods.name: guess_content_type
methods.description: Determines content type based on file extension.

methods.name: filesystem_path
methods.description: Resolves request URL to filesystem path, preventing directory traversal.

methods.name: list_items
methods.description: Generates HTML list items for directory contents.

methods.name: get_headers
methods.description: Loads headers for static files, including custom headers.

methods.name: load_headers
methods.description: Reads header info from associated header files.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Returns file data, supporting byte-range requests.

methods.name: set_response_multipart
methods.description: Prepares multipart response for multiple byte ranges.

methods.name: get_range_data
methods.description: Reads a specific byte range from a file.

methods.name: handle_request
methods.description: Handles request processing for various handlers, including executing scripts, returning JSON, or static content.
